title: Strieber's childhood mind-control camp at Randolph AFB

tellings.quote: summer camp at Randolph Air Force Base near their home in Texas >> where Strieber alleges that he was subjected to various types of physical torture and mind control experiments

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, known for books about his own encounters with strange beings, says that as a boy in the 1950s he was sent to a summer camp at Randolph Air Force Base, near his family's home in Texas, where he was put through physical torture and mind-control experiments. The researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani relays this on the show as Strieber's own allegation. If true, it would mean the military experimented on children.
